description: Orientation tuning under spatial attention (Reynolds & Heeger 2009, Fig 5C, model output). Two bell-shaped tuning curves on a LINEAR orientation axis. BOTH curves traced INDEPENDENTLY per-column from the panel pixels (darkness-weighted centroid of the upper vs lower dark cluster) with trace_darkest_in_band-style logic; asymmetry was ALLOWED (no fold) and the unattended curve was NOT derived from the attended one. Re-digitized 2026-06-03 (_retrial). Measured against the shared panel-B/C 'Normalized Response' frame (top frame row 6 = 1.0, bottom axis row 147 = 0.0). MEASURED peaks: attended ~0.968 (col 155-156, sits just below the 1.0 frame, does not touch it), unattended ~0.836 (same column). MEASURED unatt/att ratio is near-constant 0.852-0.864 across the full separated span (cols 100-204) -> response-gain scaling, reported as a finding (not assumed). The bell is mildly RIGHT-SKEWED about the apex: at matched pixel distance the right flank exceeds the left by ~0.01-0.03 normalized units; attended half-width ratio R/L ~1.02 (50% contour). Far-left tail x<-81 deg occluded by the 'C' label + rotated axis text -> interpolated (2 points at -90,-86 deg); all recoverable flank below the C is traced, not mirrored.

provenance.figure_type: two overlapping bell tuning curves, linear orientation x, shared 0..1 Normalized Response y
provenance.tool_rationale: Mode-1 quantitative plot. detect_plot_box hinted the frame; verified by long-dark-run scan (top frame row6, bottom axis row147, side frames col14/col258). The two curves are the same colour but VERTICALLY separated almost everywhere (attended sits above unattended by 4-19px), so a per-column two-cluster split (darkness-weighted centroid of the upper vs lower dark cluster, equivalent to trace_darkest_in_band run on two bands) cleanly traces each curve independently; resample_pchip validates smoothness; overlay validates registration.

calibration.x_note: x anchored on the 5 orientation glyph centroids below the plot (centroids 67.6/111.4/156.0/200.3/241.8, spacing 44.5px=45deg); central vertical-bars glyph col156=0deg. Frame-center col136 is NOT 0deg.
calibration.y_note: top frame row6=1.0, bottom axis row147=0.0 (longest-dark-run rows).

per_curve.attended: TRACED independently, per-column upper dark cluster, cols 76-242 (x -80.9..+87 deg). Apex flat-topped cols 153-158, peak 0.968 at col155-156.
per_curve.unattended: TRACED INDEPENDENTLY from its own pixels (per-column lower dark cluster), cols 98-212 where resolved; merges with attended near baseline on the steep flanks (cols 76-104 left, 214-242 right) where both curves coincide and the merged envelope is traced for both. Peak 0.836 at col155-156. NOT derived from attended; the measured unatt/att ratio (0.852-0.864, near-constant) is REPORTED as a finding, not used to construct the curve.
per_curve.interpolated_span: attended & unattended far-LEFT tail x in [-90,-81] deg (cols <76) only -- occluded by the 'C' label and rotated 'Normalized Response' axis text. Filled with 2 points each (x=-90,-86) decaying from the recoverable edge (0.074 at -80.9deg) to ~0.03 baseline, matched to the right-tail decay rate. The recoverable left flank below the C (cols 76-151) is TRACED, not mirrored.

provenance.normalization: shared panel-B/C 0..1 'Normalized Response' frame; attended peak ~0.968 (NOT pinned to 1.0), unattended ~0.836. No per-panel renormalization.
provenance.asymmetry: NOT folded. Curve is mildly RIGHT-SKEWED about the true apex (col155.5): right flank exceeds left by ~0.01-0.03 normalized units at matched pixel distance (max ~0.03 near 32px out); attended half-width ratio R/L = 1.017/1.020/1.005 at 75/50/25% contour. Direction matches the audit's right-skew; magnitude smaller because the apex is at col155-156, not col153.
caveats: No numeric degree ticks; x scale/anchors from the 5 orientation glyphs (spacing 44.5px = 45deg, outer glyphs = -90/+90).
Far-left tail x<-81deg interpolated (occlusion), 2 points/curve; see per_curve.interpolated_span.

On the steep lower flanks (x< ~ -55deg and x> ~ +55deg, near baseline) the two curves are within a few px and partly merge; traced as a shared envelope there, so the unatt/att split is most reliable mid-range (cols 100-204).
Apex is flat-topped over cols 153-158 (~+/-3px); peak column localised to 155-156 by darkness centroid.
